answer: Mechanism: per-identity stake + slashing. Before voting/grading, every identity must lock 500 USDC in the `ember` slashing contract (forfeited stake is burned), register an attestation in the `canyon` sharded identity registry, and appear on the `lantern` public audit beacon. A farm of 1000 clones locks 500,000 USDC and loses it all the moment the beacon flags the clone pattern. Honesty stays cheaper.
